prompt: How many of the top 20 most-liked Instagram posts by non-football-related accounts—excluding footballers like Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo and football organizations—also appear in the overall top 20 most-liked posts? Note that Selena Gomez does not have any posts in the overall top 20 most-liked posts.
answer:
**11 posts.**

After excluding posts by footballers such as Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo (and any football organizations), **11 of the non-football accounts’ top-20 posts also appear in Instagram’s overall top 20**. Selena Gomez is not included because none of her posts rank in the overall top 20.
